# Sync support skeleton - non destructive
```{r}
manifest_path <- "dev/support-manifest.csv"
support_index_path <- "support/index.qmd"

category_cards_begin <-
  "<!-- BEGIN GENERATED SUPPORT CATEGORY CARDS -->"

category_cards_end <-
  "<!-- END GENERATED SUPPORT CATEGORY CARDS -->"

article_list_begin <-
  "<!-- BEGIN GENERATED SUPPORT ARTICLE LIST -->"

article_list_end <-
  "<!-- END GENERATED SUPPORT ARTICLE LIST -->"


# Read and validate --------------------------------------------------------

support_manifest <- read.csv(
  manifest_path,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

required_columns <- c(
  "category_order",
  "category_id",
  "category_title",
  "category_folder",
  "category_description",
  "item_type",
  "item_order",
  "page_id",
  "page_title",
  "file_name",
  "relative_path",
  "content_status"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(
  required_columns,
  names(support_manifest)
)

if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing support-manifest columns: ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (anyDuplicated(support_manifest$page_id)) {
  stop("Duplicate support page IDs found.")
}

if (anyDuplicated(support_manifest$relative_path)) {
  stop("Duplicate support paths found.")
}

if (!file.exists(support_index_path)) {
  stop("Missing support/index.qmd.")
}

category_rows <- support_manifest[
  support_manifest$item_type == "category",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

article_rows <- support_manifest[
  support_manifest$item_type == "article",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

category_rows <- category_rows[
  order(category_rows$category_order),
]

article_rows <- article_rows[
  order(
    article_rows$category_order,
    article_rows$item_order
  ),
]


# Helpers -----------------------------------------------------------------

yaml_string <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\\\\\", x)
  x <- gsub('"', '\\"', x, fixed = TRUE)
  paste0('"', x, '"')
}

escape_html <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('"', "&quot;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}

qmd_to_html <- function(path) {
  sub("\\.qmd$", ".html", path)
}

read_utf8 <- function(path) {
  readLines(
    path,
    warn = FALSE,
    encoding = "UTF-8"
  )
}

write_utf8 <- function(lines, path) {
  dir.create(
    dirname(path),
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  writeLines(
    lines,
    con = path,
    useBytes = TRUE
  )
}

replace_generated_block <- function(
  lines,
  begin_marker,
  end_marker,
  replacement,
  path
) {
  begin_position <- which(lines == begin_marker)
  end_position <- which(lines == end_marker)

  if (
    length(begin_position) != 1 ||
    length(end_position) != 1 ||
    begin_position >= end_position
  ) {
    stop(
      "Missing or invalid generated markers in: ",
      path
    )
  }

  before <- if (begin_position > 1) {
    lines[seq_len(begin_position - 1)]
  } else {
    character()
  }

  after <- if (end_position < length(lines)) {
    lines[(end_position + 1):length(lines)]
  } else {
    character()
  }

  c(
    before,
    begin_marker,
    replacement,
    end_marker,
    after
  )
}


# Main Segítségtár cards ---------------------------------------------------

build_category_cards <- function(categories) {
  cards <- vapply(
    seq_len(nrow(categories)),
    function(i) {
      row <- categories[i, , drop = FALSE]

      href <- paste0(
        escape_html(row$category_folder[[1]]),
        "/index.html"
      )

      paste0(
        '<article class="support-card">',
        "<h3>",
        escape_html(row$category_title[[1]]),
        "</h3>",
        '<p class="support-card__description">',
        escape_html(row$category_description[[1]]),
        "</p>",
        '<p class="support-card__action">',
        '<a class="btn btn-primary" href="',
        href,
        '">Kisokos megnyitása</a>',
        "</p>",
        "</article>"
      )
    },
    character(1)
  )

  c(
    "```{=html}",
    '<div class="support-map">',
    cards,
    "</div>",
    "```"
  )
}

support_index_lines <- read_utf8(
  support_index_path
)

support_index_lines <- replace_generated_block(
  lines = support_index_lines,
  begin_marker = category_cards_begin,
  end_marker = category_cards_end,
  replacement = build_category_cards(category_rows),
  path = support_index_path
)

write_utf8(
  support_index_lines,
  support_index_path
)


# Category pages -----------------------------------------------------------

create_category_page <- function(row) {
  c(
    "---",
    paste0(
      "title: ",
      yaml_string(row$category_title[[1]])
    ),
    'subtitle: "Opcionális segítség"',
    'page-type: "support_category"',
    paste0(
      "category-id: ",
      yaml_string(row$category_id[[1]])
    ),
    paste0(
      "content-status: ",
      yaml_string(row$content_status[[1]])
    ),
    "toc: false",
    "---",
    "",
    "[← Vissza a Segítségtárhoz](../index.qmd)",
    "",
    "## Miről szól ez a kisokos?",
    "",
    row$category_description[[1]],
    "",
    "## A kisokos anyagai",
    "",
    article_list_begin,
    article_list_end,
    ""
  )
}

build_article_list <- function(articles) {
  if (nrow(articles) == 0) {
    return(c(
      "::: {.callout-note}",
      "Ehhez a kisokoshoz még nem kerültek fel tananyagok.",
      ":::"
    ))
  }

  cards <- vapply(
    seq_len(nrow(articles)),
    function(i) {
      row <- articles[i, , drop = FALSE]

      href <- qmd_to_html(
        escape_html(row$file_name[[1]])
      )

      paste0(
        '<a class="support-article-card" href="',
        href,
        '">',
        "</span>",
        '<span class="support-article-card__title">',
        escape_html(row$page_title[[1]]),
        "</span>",
        '<span class="support-article-card__arrow">',
        "Megnyitás →",
        "</span>",
        "</a>"
      )
    },
    character(1)
  )

  c(
    "```{=html}",
    '<div class="support-article-list">',
    cards,
    "</div>",
    "```"
  )
}

for (i in seq_len(nrow(category_rows))) {
  category <- category_rows[i, , drop = FALSE]
  category_path <- category$relative_path[[1]]

  dir.create(
    dirname(category_path),
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  if (!file.exists(category_path)) {
    write_utf8(
      create_category_page(category),
      category_path
    )

    message("Created category page: ", category_path)
  }

  category_articles <- article_rows[
    article_rows$category_id ==
      category$category_id[[1]],
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  category_articles <- category_articles[
    order(category_articles$item_order),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  category_lines <- read_utf8(category_path)

  category_lines <- replace_generated_block(
    lines = category_lines,
    begin_marker = article_list_begin,
    end_marker = article_list_end,
    replacement = build_article_list(category_articles),
    path = category_path
  )

  write_utf8(
    category_lines,
    category_path
  )
}


# Article placeholders -----------------------------------------------------

create_article_page <- function(row) {
  c(
    "---",
    paste0(
      "title: ",
      yaml_string(row$page_title[[1]])
    ),
    paste0(
      "subtitle: ",
      yaml_string(row$category_title[[1]])
    ),
    'page-type: "support_article"',
    paste0(
      "page-id: ",
      yaml_string(row$page_id[[1]])
    ),
    paste0(
      "category-id: ",
      yaml_string(row$category_id[[1]])
    ),
    paste0(
      "content-status: ",
      yaml_string(row$content_status[[1]])
    ),
    "toc: false",
    "---",
    "",
    paste0(
      "[← ",
      row$category_title[[1]],
      "](index.qmd)"
    ),
    "",
    "[Segítségtár kezdőlap](../index.qmd)",
    "",
    "::: {.callout-note}",
    paste0(
      "A **",
      row$page_title[[1]],
      "** oldal végleges tartalma később kerül ide."
    ),
    ":::",
    "",
    "## Miről lesz szó?",
    "",
    "[Rövid bevezető helye.]",
    "",
    "## Tartalom",
    "",
    "[Az opcionális tananyag helye.]",
    ""
  )
}

for (i in seq_len(nrow(article_rows))) {
  article <- article_rows[i, , drop = FALSE]
  article_path <- article$relative_path[[1]]

  if (!file.exists(article_path)) {
    write_utf8(
      create_article_page(article),
      article_path
    )

    message("Created support article: ", article_path)
  } else {
    message(
      "Existing support article preserved: ",
      article_path
    )
  }
}


# Validation ---------------------------------------------------------------

expected_paths <- support_manifest$relative_path

missing_paths <- expected_paths[
  !file.exists(expected_paths)
]

if (length(missing_paths) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Support pages missing after synchronization:\n",
    paste(missing_paths, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

created_article_count <- sum(
  file.exists(article_rows$relative_path)
)

if (created_article_count != 18) {
  stop(
    "Expected 18 support articles but found ",
    created_article_count,
    "."
  )
}

message(
  "Support skeleton synchronized successfully: ",
  nrow(category_rows),
  " categories and ",
  nrow(article_rows),
  " articles."
)
```
